arithmetic.direct: reviewer-trust-weighted mean over reconciled pairs with floor at 1e6 score scale
arithmetic.propagation: positive edges only; personalized fixed-mass iteration with 0.85 damping, Hamilton apportionment, 64 iterations
arithmetic.tieOrder: descending value then ascending qualified agent key

coverage.attributionDenominator: pinned-registry records at or before the cutoff with the exact tag, unit, and decimals, before target, value, reviewer-eligibility, revocation, or pair filters
coverage.missingness: an absent reconciled pair is missing evidence, never zero or negative evidence
coverage.pairDenominator: eligible reviewer count multiplied by declared target count, excluding reviewer-target self pairs
coverage.policyRecordDenominator: records from the pinned registry at or before the cutoff

feedback.interpretation: signed integer points on a closed 0..100 scale; zero is observed non-positive evidence

historicalAttribution.source: verified-wallet relation history strictly before the feedback event position

pairReconciliation.responses: preserve for reporting but do not alter value or validity
pairReconciliation.revocations: exclude the revoked record without deleting history; reconcile remaining active records
pairReconciliation.rule: latest active feedback by ascending blockNumber, transactionIndex, logIndex, id
